body:
Lazard has completed its acquisition of Campbell Lutyens and launched Lazard CL, creating a global private capital advisory business that the company expects to generate approximately $500 million in combined revenue in 2027.

The acquisition was originally announced on April 30, 2026.

Lazard CL combines Lazard’s existing private capital advisory capabilities with Campbell Lutyens’ fundraising and secondary advisory operations.

The business has more than 300 advisory professionals across 19 offices worldwide.

Collectively, the teams have advised on more than $1 trillion of primary capital raised and secondary transaction volume across approximately 1,300 mandates over the past four decades.

Lazard CL will provide services spanning primary fundraising, fund placement, secondary advisory, and GP capital advisory.

Its dedicated distribution organization includes more than 60 professionals connecting approximately 4,000 institutional investors with investment opportunities and liquidity solutions.

The business operates across private equity, private credit, infrastructure, and real estate.

Lazard CL also has proprietary datasets containing approximately 100,000 investor sentiment data points and roughly 20,000 fund pricing data points.

The company plans to combine those datasets with Lazard’s AI capabilities to support benchmarking, positioning, and investor targeting.

The launch represents a major component of Lazard’s 2030 strategy to expand recurring and diversified revenue streams while strengthening connections between private capital advisory and its M&A, restructuring, capital markets, and other financial advisory businesses.

The upfront acquisition consideration was paid primarily in Lazard shares, with portions subject to lock-up arrangements lasting as long as three years.

Lazard said Campbell Lutyens is currently performing ahead of the assumptions used when the acquisition was announced.

The company continues to expect Lazard CL to be accretive to earnings in 2027 before considering potential revenue or cost synergies.

“We are thrilled to launch our third global business, Lazard CL.”

Peter Orszag, CEO And Chairman Of Lazard

“Today, Lazard CL opens its doors as the largest integrated platform in private capital advisory anywhere in the world.”

Gordon Bajnai, Co-CEO Of Lazard CL

“This transaction augments our standout capabilities in private equity and real estate with category leadership in infrastructure and private credit.”

Holcombe Green, Co-CEO Of Lazard CL
